The '''Walin'or system''' was located in the [[Shiwal sector/Legends|Shiwal sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] to the [[Mapuzo system/Legends|Mapuzo system]] in the [[Hollan sector/Legends|Hollan sector]] and the [[Belukat system/Legends|Belukat system]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EGTW" />

The Walin'or system was the origin point of<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Walin'or cell]]|system=Walin'or [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Walin'or cell]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], Walin'or served as a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] stronghold. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the New Republic [[Endurance-class fleet carrier|fleet carrier]] [[Endurance (Endurance-class)|''Endurance'']] traveled through the Walin'or system as part of a [[Orinda campaign|military campaign]] against the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Walin'or system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-7. In a map of the Mid Rim included in the book, the system's name was misspelled as "Walinor."<ref name="TEA" />
